AI is rapidly rewriting the process and paperwork layer for Receptionists And Information Clerks, but on-site judgment and professional experience still rest with people. This article breaks down the specific impact and how to respond.

It does not suit hot-tempered people, those unable to tolerate interruptions, or those who become confused around many people. Reception is constantly multitasking and handling requests, which can be difficult for highly sensitive workers.
A common path is: begin in administration / secretarial work → receptionist → administrative specialist → administrative supervisor or secretary.
This career suits organized, even-tempered, responsive people willing to own details. If your standard is receiving people smoothly, you can succeed in this field.
